dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The dorsal-lateral surface exhibits multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped light-intensity perimeters against a dark coat. These include a large, jagged irregular ring in the dorsal midsection and several interlocking partial arcs extending toward the posterior. The transitions consist of high-contrast, non-linear pixel lines enclosing dark-intensity interior regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density of solid pixel clusters. The high-intensity data is primarily organized into thin, filamentary lines rather than solid blobs. Minor concentrations of high-intensity pixels occur only at the intersections of the light-colored annuli lines.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent ring-like structures form a non-equilateral trapezoidal geometric relationship across the mid-dorsal and posterior-lateral regions.

other_distinctive_markers: A localized cluster of high-intensity red pixels is visible in the ocular region, creating a sharp contrast with the surrounding low-intensity cephalic pixels.
